blocks.text: Here are the biggest headlines from Trump's Asia tour on Tuesday, November 17:
Canada, China agree to ease tariffs amid trade rows with US

blocks.caption: Carney (L) and Xi held talks ahead of the APEC summit in ShenzhenImage: Adrian Wyld/The Canadian Press/AP Photo/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Talks between Chinese President Xi Jinping and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney ahead of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit in Shenzhen have produced deals to further reduce tariffs, Ottawa said on Tuesday.

The agreements reflect a growing rapprochement between the two countries after years of strained relations, thanks to trade tensions with Washington leading both Canada and China to seek to reduce dependence on the US.
